text:
alyssa: Quick heads-up — NorthCloud and we are co-running a one-day "Edge Builders" hackathon on 2024-06-18. Main asks: localized breakout rooms (EN/FR/DE), 30 hardware loaner kits, live captions in three languages, and a post-event developer credits distribution. Who can take ownership of each?

sam: I can own logistics for hardware pickup + dropoff. Need list of recipients and shipping windows. ETA on final headcount? :shipit:

maria: I can scope captions/localization. Do we want human-edited captions or auto-CC with post-event QC? Also can translate slides into FR/DE if we get source.

devlin: For hardware: are these loaner GPUs or dev boxes? Need customs paperwork for EU deliveries — we should collect EORI numbers from recipients. Also suggest a local pickup hub in Amsterdam to avoid per-person customs.

frank: On credits: should we do platform sandbox credits + a partner promo code? We can generate 1-time activation codes tied to emails. Also recommend a 30-day lab VM access for hands-on sessions.

partnerbot: NorthCloud here — we can provide 10 local loaner units in EU, and we’ll handle customs for those. We’ll also supply two engineers for breakout moderation.

alyssa: Nice, @partnerbot — thanks. Action items so far: Sam = shipping plan + pickup hub; Maria = captions/translations plan; Devlin = customs checklist + loaner inventory; Frank = promo codes + sandbox provisioning.

sam: I’ll draft a shipping timeline by EOD tomorrow. Need a final list of 30 recipients by 2024-06-03. Can we get a spreadsheet with columns: name, email, country, EORI(if EU), preferred pickup?

maria: Proposal: use auto-CC live (Otter/streaming) during the event, then have a 24-48hr human QC pass and publish translated captions and slide deck. That keeps latency low during sessions. Anyone opposed?

devlin: Agrees with Maria. Also +1 for a local hub in Amsterdam. I’ll map carrier options and estimate customs duties. Please mark high-priority recipients (speakers, demos) so they get priority shipping.

frank: On codes: I’ll prepare two coupon buckets — "hackathon-early" (50 credits) and "hackathon-partner" (100 credits). We’ll need attendee emails to generate codes. Also recommend rate-limiting to prevent abuse.

alyssa: Ok. One more ask — breakout ops: we need 6 live support engineers across timezones to hop between rooms. Can @eng-oncall volunteer pool cover this? If not, we’ll recruit from partners.

sam: I can arrange on-site volunteer slots and a volunteer rotation schedule. Will post a signup sheet. :calendar:

partnerbot: We’ll share speaker bios + demo repos by 2024-06-01. Also happy to co-brand a follow-up "Getting Started" notebook we can pre-load on the loaners.

alyssa: Perfect. Next sync in two days to confirm shipping spreadsheet and captions approach. Thanks all — I’ll assemble a single shared tracker and ping you. :rocket:
